canonical_antichain_invariant.statement: Frozen canon_cnf removes every clause B for which an already-kept clause A satisfies A subseteq B. Therefore every nonterminal canonical residual is an antichain in the poset of consistent signed literal sets ordered by inclusion.

signed_clause_poset.maximal_chain_model: Choose a permutation of the n variables and one sign for each variable; add the signed literals in permutation order.

signed_LYM_lemma.statement: For every canonical clause antichain A on n variables, sum_{C in A} 1/(C(n,|C|)*2^|C|) <= 1.
signed_LYM_lemma.proof: A random maximal signed chain intersects an antichain at most once. Summing the inclusion probabilities of its members gives the expected intersection size, which is <=1.

weighted_canonical_size_theorem.name: SIGNED_LYM_STATE_UNITS_CEILING
weighted_canonical_size_theorem.statement: For every canonical CNF F over n live variables, state_units(F)<=Smax(n)=1+max_{1<=k<=n}((k+1)*C(n,k)*2^k).
proof: For a clause C of rank k, write its state-unit contribution k+1 as ((k+1)R(n,k))*(1/R(n,k)).
Let M=max_k((k+1)R(n,k)). Then sum_C(k+1)<=M*sum_C 1/R(n,|C|)<=M by signed LYM.
Add the single global state_units constant 1.

combined_reachable_envelope.transition: At a unit-free ordinary state with n>2 live variables and size bound s, if T(s)<=N^2 then every pivot is cap-safe. After the chosen exact elimination and any unit propagation, the next state has n'<=n-1 and state_units<=min(T(s),Smax(n-1)).
combined_reachable_envelope.terminal_floor: When live variables <=2, every remaining clause has width<=2 and the exact 2-SAT lane is evaluated before ordinary elimination/rescue.

range_extension.through_N19: Inherited from audited exact-rational size-only envelope theorem.

theorem.name: NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N22
theorem.statement: For every legitimate root with frozen input size N<=22, any nonterminal frozen run can continue by ordinary exact elimination whenever it reaches the ordinary stage, until either an earlier exact lane terminates or at most two live variables remain and the exact 2-SAT lane applies. Therefore v2/v3 cannot be required because ordinary elimination lacks N^2 raw-cap availability on these input-size layers.

first_unresolved_by_combined_envelope.interpretation: The sufficient combined envelope no longer guarantees the next ordinary pivot at this point. This does not establish existence of any legitimate N23 failure, extension use, or OPEN.

relationship_to_N20_exhaustive_matrix: The concurrently running exhaustive N20 r0=4,5,6 jobs are now regression evidence rather than necessary proof for cap availability; the signed-LYM theorem already closes N20 for all legitimate roots.
next_exact_target: Attack the N23,n=4 canonical frontier using exact signed-antichain bucket structure or complete legitimate-root forward replay for r0=8,9; do not modify frozen grammar before a reachable gap is established.
